case_title: Shaji And Ors. v. State Of Kerala
accused_occupation: Worker and helper in the Oil Mill
weapon: Chopper, iron bars, iron pipe, wooden sticks
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under Sections 143, 147, 148, 342, 449 and 302 read with Section 149 of IPC
neutral_facts: The accused formed an unlawful assembly and attacked the victim, resulting in his death. The accused were armed with deadly weapons. The victim was taken to a hospital where he was declared dead. The prosecution relied on eyewitness accounts and medical evidence to establish the incident. The trial court convicted several accused, but the Supreme Court found that the evidence did not sufficiently establish the common object of the unlawful assembly for the conviction of the other accused.
